name: feature.app-builder.nodes
description: App-builder canvas producer node pack (+ code export and a canvas-to-work proposal adapter). The `render` node emits a typed `canvas.app-builder` artifact — a structured app design { name, screens[], connectors[] } with a component tree per screen — that renders inline in the chat artifact workbench. The `export` node generates framework-native source (React/Vue/HTML) from an app design → a downloadable Media-asset token via ctx.features['app-builder'].export. The proposal adapter reads an existing canvas and emits generic Kanban work inputs; core Kanban owns the board write. Constrained typed JSON, never executable code; replay-safe.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Render app design
nodes.description: Emit a `canvas.app-builder` artifact. Inputs: { app } (or `source` JSON) = { name, description?, theme?, screens: [{ id, name, route?, isInitial?, components: [tree] }], connectors?: [{ from, to, trigger?, label? }] }. Components reference the host app-builder catalog by `type`. Output: a typed canvas.app-builder artifact. Pure transform.

nodes.label: Export app source
nodes.description: Generate framework-native source from an app design over ctx.features['app-builder'].export. Inputs: { target: 'react-tailwind'|'react-styled'|'vue-tailwind'|'html-css', app?: <inline canvas.app-builder model>, canvasId?: <stored canvas id> }. Output: { assetToken, serveUrl, fileName, fileCount, warnings }. The token downloads a ZIP via /assets/:token. Recorded output → replay-safe.

nodes.label: App research
nodes.description: ONE BYOK call producing structured product research — personas[], brand voice, visualDirection (incl. theme-color suggestions) — from { idea, prd }. SOFT-FAILS loudly (warning carries the error code). Output: { content: JSON string, research?, planContext, warning? } — planContext is the PRD+research combined text intended as the downstream chat node's SOLE input (multi-port prompts are dropped by toMessages).

nodes.label: Deepen screens
nodes.description: Per-screen content depth (ADR 0325): enriches the ≤4 thinnest screens (component count < minComponents, default 5) with one BYOK call each, re-normalized through the SAME gate as render; the input artifact is DEEP-CLONED (never mutated — the scheduler delivers by reference). Config { maxScreens clamped 0..4, minComponents }. Output: { artifact, deepened[], warning? }.

nodes.label: Quality audit
nodes.description: DETERMINISTIC (zero AI) semantic quality checks: unreachable screens, empty screens, dangling navigateTo, duplicate routes, indistinct theme pair, deepen-skipped (from upstreamWarning). Output: { artifact (pass-through), report: { score, findings[], summary } } — deliberately NO top-level string outputs (the approval gate folds strings into picker options) and the whole map flows to the gate so detectTypedArtifact finds `.artifact`.

nodes.name: Capture typed artifact
nodes.description: Wraps an upstream value into a typed artifact envelope (config: artifactTypeId, title) so the run persists a schema-validated typed deliverable.

artifact.description: The typed artifact envelope (absent when the input was empty).

nodes.name: Repair app design
nodes.description: Governed repair: reads the current canvas.app-builder design through the feature surface, applies the repair instructions with one AI call, and re-normalizes the candidate through the render gate. Outputs the candidate artifact plus the CAS basis (canvasId, baseVersion).

instructions.description: What to repair — finding codes or a description.

baseVersion.description: The version the candidate was built from (the applyRepair CAS basis).

nodes.name: Apply approved repair
nodes.description: CAS-writes the APPROVED repair candidate as a new working-copy version through the feature surface (expectedVersion = the candidate's basis; concurrent edits 409).

nodes.label: Propose App Builder work
nodes.description: Reads a stored canvas.app-builder design through its feature surface and emits the generic { scope, source, items } proposal consumed by core.openwop.kanban.work-items.materialize. Each screen becomes a task; forward screen-flow connectors become safe dependency edges, while back-navigation is reported and never creates a cycle. This node does not write a board.

nodes.label: App Builder: Deploy App
nodes.description: Deploys an exported app (prebuilt image, symbolic env keys ONLY) to the operator-configured provider via ctx.features['app-builder'].deployApp (ADR 0424). Sub-toggle `app-builder.deploy` gated + honest-off without a provider. Idempotent on (service, exportHash, image) — a replay never re-deploys. Compose AFTER core.approvalGate. Inputs: { orgId, service, image, exportHash, envKeys[] }. Output: { deployment }.

nodes.label: App Builder: Deployment Status
nodes.description: Reads a governed deployment record by deployKey (tenant-guarded read). Inputs: { deployKey }. Output: { deployment | null }.
